remarks: Welcome to Kingsley Court, in the heart of Norwalk! This delightful ground-floor condo offers the perfect blend of convenience and value. Step inside the charming brick building to a two bedroom single level condo. This home has a private entrance, hardwood floors and a remodeled kitchen with granite countertops and gas range. Enjoy the manicured park-like grounds and walkways. With a central Norwalk location, you'll enjoy easy access to all the amenities this vibrant city has to offer. Whether it's shopping, dining, entertainment, commuting connections or proximity to Norwalk Hospital, everything is just moments away from your doorstep. Reserved parking adds to the convenience. Don't miss out on this affordable opportunity to experience home ownership. Make an appointment soon and make Kingsley Court your new home.
